216	    ------------------------------------------------------------
217	          1     -3.763233752583  -3.7947704E+00   1.3823013E-07
218	          2     -3.763233751557   1.0256169E-09   1.4215249E-08
219	    ------------------------------------------------------------
220	
221	    Raises
222	    ------
223	    TBliteValueError
224	        on invalid input, like incorrect shape / type of the passed arrays
225	
226	    TBLiteRuntimeError
227	        if a requested quantity is not available in the container
228	    """
229	
230	    _res = library.ffi.NULL
231	    _natoms = 0
232	    _getter = {
233	        "energy": library.get_energy,
234	        "energies": library.get_energies,
235	        "gradient": library.get_gradient,
236	        "virial": library.get_virial,
237	        "charges": library.get_charges,
238	        "bond-orders": library.get_bond_orders,
239	        "dipole": library.get_dipole,
240	        "quadrupole": library.get_quadrupole,
241	        "orbital-energies": library.get_orbital_energies,
242	        "orbital-occupations": library.get_orbital_occupations,
243	        "orbital-coefficients": library.get_orbital_coefficients,
244	        "density-matrix": library.get_density_matrix,
245	        "overlap-matrix": library.get_overlap_matrix,
246	        "hamiltonian-matrix": library.get_hamiltonian_matrix,
247	        "post-processing-dict": library.get_post_processing_dict,
248	        "natoms": library.get_number_of_atoms,
249	        "norbitals": library.get_number_of_orbitals,
250	    }
251	    _setter = {}
252	
253	    def __init__(self, other=None):
254	        """
255	        Instantiate a new Result container, in case an existing container is passed
256	        all existing results will be copied into the newly created container as well.
257	        """
258	        if other is not None:
259	            self._res = library.copy_result(other._res)
260	        else:
261	            self._res = library.new_result()
262	
263	    def get(self, attribute: str):
264	        """
265	        Get a quantity stored instade the result container.
266	        The following quantities are available
267	
268	        ====================== ================================= ==============
269	         property               dimension [spin-polarized case]   unit
270	        ====================== ================================= ==============
271	         energy                 scalar                            Hartree
272	         energies               nat                               Hartree
273	         gradient               nat, 3                            Hartree/Bohr
274	         virial                 3, 3                              Hartree
275	         charges                nat                               e
276	         bond-orders            nat, nat                          e
277	         dipole                 3                                 e·Bohr
278	         quadrupole             6                                 e·Bohr²
279	         orbital-energies       norb [2, norb]                    Hartree
280	         orbital-occupations    norb [2, norb]                    e
281	         orbital-coefficients   norb, norb [2, norb, norb]        unitless
282	         overlap-matrix         norb, norb                        unitless
283	         hamiltonian-matrix     norb, norb                        Hartree
284	         density-matrix         norb, norb [2, norb, norb]        e
285	         natoms                 scalar                            unitless
286	         norbitals              scalar                            unitless
287	         post-processing-dict   dependes on the key               /
288	        ====================== ================================= ==============
289	
290	        Notes
291	        -----
292	        The Hamiltonian matrix is the core Hamiltonian rather than the
293	        converged full Hamiltonian after selfconsistency. To reconstruct it
294	        transform the orbital energies from the MO to the AO basis using
295	        the orbital coefficients.
296	
297	        Raises
298	        ------
299	        TBLiteValueError
300	            on invalid input, like incorrect shape / type of the passed arrays
301	
302	        TBLiteRuntimeError
303	            if a requested quantity is not available in the container
304	        """
305	
306	        if attribute not in self._getter:
307	            raise TBLiteValueError(
308	                f"Attribute '{attribute}' is not available in this result"
309	            )
310	
311	        return self._getter[attribute](self._res)
312	
313	    def set(self, attribute: str, value):
314	        """
315	        Get a quantity stored instade the result container.
316	        Currently, no quantities can be set in the result container.
317	
318	        Raises
319	        ------
320	        TBLiteValueError
321	            on invalid input, like incorrect shape / type of the passed arrays
322	
323	        TBLiteRuntimeError
324	            if a requested quantity cannot be set in the container
325	        """
326	
327	        if attribute not in self._setter:
328	            raise TBLiteValueError(
329	                f"Attribute '{attribute}' cannot be set in this result"
330	            )
331	
332	        self._setter[attribute](self._res, value)
333	
334	    def save(self, filename: str) -> None:
335	        """
336	        Save the result container to a file. The format is compatible with the
337	        npz format, which is used by the numpy library and can be read
338	        by the numpy.load function.
339	
340	        Raises
341	        ------
342	        TBLiteRuntimeError
343	            if the saving fails
344	        """
345	        library.save_wavefunction(self._res, filename)
346	
347	    def load(self, filename: str) -> None:
348	        """
349	        Load a result container from a file. The format is compatible with the
350	        npz format, which is used by the numpy library and can be written
351	        by the numpy.savez function.
352	
353	        Raises
354	        ------
355	        TBLiteRuntimeError
356	            if the loading fails
357	        """
358	        library.load_wavefunction(self._res, filename)
359	
360	    def __getitem__(self, key: str) -> Any:
361	        return self.get(key)
362	
363	    def __setitem__(self, key: str, value: Any) -> None:
364	        self.set(key, value)
365	
366	    def dict(self) -> dict:
367	        """
368	        Return all quantities inside the result container as dict. In case no
369	        results are present an empty dict is returned.
370	        """
371	        res = {}
372	
373	        for key in self._getter:
374	            try:
375	                res[key] = self.get(key)
376	            except (TBLiteValueError, TBLiteRuntimeError):
377	                pass
378	
379	        return res

382	class Calculator(Structure):
383	    """
384	    .. Single point calculator
385	
386	    Represents a wrapped calculator object in ``tblite`` and the associated structure data.
387	    The calculator is instantiated for the respective structure and is immutable once
388	    created. The cartesian coordinates and the lattice parameters of the structure can
389	    be updated, while changing the boundary conditions, atomic types or number of atoms
390	    require the complete reconstruction of the calculator instance.
391	
392	    Available methods to parametrization of the calculator are:
393	
394	    **GFN2-xTB**:
395	
396	    Self-consistent extended tight binding Hamiltonian with
397	    anisotropic second order electrostatic contributions,
398	    third order on-site contributions and self-consistent D4 dispersion.
399	
400	    Geometry, frequency and non-covalent interactions parametrisation for
401	    elements up to Z=86.
402	
403	    Cite as:
404	
405	    * C. Bannwarth, S. Ehlert and S. Grimme.,
406	      *J. Chem. Theory Comput.* (2019), **15**, 1652-1671.
407	      DOI: `10.1021/acs.jctc.8b01176 <https://dx.doi.org/10.1021/acs.jctc.8b01176>`_
408	
409	    **GFN1-xTB**:
410	
411	    Self-consistent extended tight binding Hamiltonian with
412	    isotropic second order electrostatic contributions and
413	    third order on-site contributions.
414	
415	    Geometry, frequency and non-covalent interactions parametrisation for
416	    elements up to Z=86.
417	
418	    Cite as:
419	
420	    * S. Grimme, C. Bannwarth, P. Shushkov,
421	      *J. Chem. Theory Comput.* (2017), **13**, 1989-2009.
422	      DOI: `10.1021/acs.jctc.7b00118 <https://dx.doi.org/10.1021/acs.jctc.7b00118>`_
423	
424	    **IPEA1-xTB**:
425	
426	    Special parametrisation for the GFN1-xTB Hamiltonian to improve the
427	    description of vertical ionisation potentials and electron affinities.
428	    Uses additional diffuse s-functions on light main group elements.
429	    Parametrised up to Z=86.
430	
431	    Cite as:
432	
433	    * V. Asgeirsson, C. Bauer and S. Grimme, *Chem. Sci.* (2017), **8**, 4879.
434	      DOI: `10.1039/c7sc00601b <https://dx.doi.org/10.1039/c7sc00601b>`_

436	    Example
437	    -------
438	    >>> from tblite.interface import Calculator

440	    >>> numbers = np.array([1, 1, 6, 5, 1, 15, 8, 17, 13, 15, 5, 1, 9, 15, 1, 15])
441	    >>> positions = np.array([  # Coordinates in Bohr
442	    ...     [+2.79274810283778, +3.82998228828316, -2.79287054959216],
443	    ...     [-1.43447454186833, +0.43418729987882, +5.53854345129809],

449	    ...     [+4.41363836635653, +3.92515871809283, +2.57961724984000],
450	    ...     [+1.33707758998700, +1.40194471661647, +1.97530004949523],

459	    >>> calc = Calculator("GFN2-xTB", numbers, positions)
460	    >>> res = calc.singlepoint()

462	    -31.716159156026254

464	    Raises
465	    ------
466	    TBLiteValueError

468	    """

488	        "orbital-map": library.get_calculator_orbital_map,

490	    }

493	        "spin-polarization": library.new_spin_polarization,

507	    def __init__(
508	        self,
509	        method: str,
510	        numbers: Union[np.ndarray, List[int]],
511	        positions: np.ndarray,
512	        charge: Optional[float] = None,
513	        uhf: Optional[int] = None,
514	        lattice: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
515	        periodic: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
516	        xtb_config: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,

518	    ):
519	        """
520	        Construct new calculator object for a given structure.
521	
522	        Raises
523	        ------
524	        TBLiteValueError
525	            on invalid input, like incorrect shape / type of the passed arrays
526	        """
527	        Structure.__init__(self, numbers, positions, charge, uhf, lattice, periodic)

529	        self._ctx = library.new_context(**context_kwargs)
530	        if method not in self._loader:
531	            raise TBLiteValueError(

537	    def set(self, attribute: str, value) -> None:
538	        """
539	        Set an attribute in the calculator instance. Supported attributes are
540	
541	        ================= ==================================== =================
542	         name              description                          default
543	        ================= ==================================== =================
544	         accuracy          Numerical thresholds for SCC         1.0
545	         guess             Initial guess for wavefunction       0 (SAD)
546	         max-iter          Maximum number of SCC iterations     250
547	         mixer-damping     Parameter for the SCC mixer          0.4
548	         save-integrals    Keep integral matrices in results    0 (False)
549	         temperature       Electronic temperature for filling   9.500e-4
550	         verbosity         Set verbosity of printout            1
551	        ================= ==================================== =================

553	        .. note::
554	
555	           The electronic temperature is given in Hartree, rather than Kelvin.
556	           The conversion factor from Kelvin to Hartree is the Boltzmann constant
557	           in Hartree/Kelvin (3.166808578545117e-6).
558	
559	        Raises
560	        ------
561	        TBLiteValueError
562	            on invalid input, like incorrect shape / type of the passed arrays
563	        """

565	        if attribute not in self._setter:
566	            raise TBLiteValueError(
567	                f"Attribute '{attribute}' is not supported in this calculator"
568	            )

571	    def add(self, interaction, *args) -> None:
572	        """
573	        Add an interaction to the calculator instance. Supported interactions are
574	
575	        =================== ============================= =========================================
576	         name                description                   Arguments
577	        =================== ============================= =========================================
578	         electric-field      Uniform electric field        Field vector (3,)
579	         spin-polarization   Spin polarization             Scaling factor
580	         alpb-solvation      ALPB implicit solvation       Solvent name, solution state (optional)
581	         gbsa-solvation      GBSA implicit solvation       Solvent name, solution state (optional)
582	         ddX-solvation       dd-based implicit solvation   Epsilon / Solvent name, model
583	         gbe-solvation       GBε implicit solvation        Epsilon, Born kernel
584	         gb-solvation        GB implicit solvation         Epsilon, Born kernel
585	        =================== ============================= =========================================
586	
587	        .. note::
588	
589	            For GSBA and ALPB:
590	            For named solvents, uses parametrized GBSA/ALPB with CDS and empirical shift.
591	            For unnamed solvents (dielectric constant), uses non-empirical GBSA/ALPB.
592	            Optional solution state correction: gsolv (default), bar1mol, reference.
593	        """
594	
595	        if interaction in self._interaction:
596	            kwargs = {}
597	            if interaction in ("alpb-solvation", "gbsa-solvation"):
598	                kwargs["version"] = {
599	                    "GFN2-xTB": 2,
600	                    "IPEA1-xTB": 1,
601	                    "GFN1-xTB": 1,
602	                }[self._method]
603	            cont = self._interaction[interaction](
604	                self._ctx, self._mol, self._calc, *args, **kwargs
605	            )
606	            library.calculator_push_back(self._ctx, self._calc, cont)
607	        elif interaction in self._post_processing:
608	            library.post_processing_push_back(
609	                self._ctx, self._calc, self._mol, self._post_processing[interaction]
610	            )
611	        elif ".toml" in interaction:
612	            library.post_processing_push_back(
613	                self._ctx, self._calc, self._mol, interaction
614	            )
615	        else:
616	            raise TBLiteValueError(
617	                f"Interaction or post processing '{interaction}' is not supported in this calculator"
618	            )

620	    def get(self, attribute: str) -> Any:
621	        """
622	        Set an attribute from the calculator instance. Supported attributes are
623	
624	        ================= ====================================
625	         name              description
626	        ================= ====================================
627	         angular-momenta   Angular momenta of shells
628	         orbital-map       Mapping from orbitals to shells
629	         shell-map         Mapping from shells to atoms
630	        ================= ====================================
631	
632	        Raises
633	        ------
634	        TBLiteValueError
635	            on invalid attributes
636	        """
637	
638	        if attribute not in self._getter:
639	            raise TBLiteValueError(
640	                f"Attribute '{attribute}' is not supported in this calculator"
641	            )
642	        return self._getter[attribute](self._ctx, self._calc)

644	    def singlepoint(self, res: Optional[Result] = None, copy: bool = False) -> Result:
645	        """
646	        Perform actual single point calculation in the library backend.
647	        The output of the library will be forwarded to the standard output.
648	
649	        The routine returns an object containing the results, which can be used
650	        to restart the calculation. Unless specified the restart object will be
651	        updated inplace rather than copied.
652	
653	        Raises
654	        ------
655	        TBLiteRuntimeError
656	            in case the calculation fails
657	        """
658	
659	        _res = Result(res) if copy or res is None else res
660	        library.get_singlepoint(self._ctx, self._mol, self._calc, _res._res)
661	        return _res

439	function fsmooth(r1, rcut) result(fcut)
440	   real(wp), intent(in) :: r1
441	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rcut
442	   real(wp) :: fcut
443	
444	   real(wp), parameter :: offset = 1.0_wp
445	   real(wp), parameter :: c(*) = [-6.0_wp, 15.0_wp, -10.0_wp, 1.0_wp]
446	   real(wp) :: xrel
447	
448	   if (r1 < rcut - offset) then
449	      fcut = 1.0_wp
450	   else if (r1 > rcut) then
451	      fcut = 0.0_wp
452	   else
453	      xrel = (r1 - (rcut - offset)) / offset
454	      fcut = c(1)*xrel**5 + c(2)*xrel**4 + c(3)*xrel**3 + c(4)
455	   end if
456	end function fsmooth

458	function dsmooth(r1, rcut) result(dcut)
459	   real(wp), intent(in) :: r1
460	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rcut
461	   real(wp) :: dcut
462	
463	   real(wp), parameter :: offset = 1.0_wp
464	   real(wp), parameter :: c(*) = [-6.0_wp, 15.0_wp, -10.0_wp, 1.0_wp]
465	   real(wp) :: xrel
466	
467	   if (r1 < rcut - offset .or. r1 > rcut) then
468	      dcut = 0.0_wp
469	   else
470	      xrel = (r1 - (rcut - offset)) / offset
471	      dcut = (5*c(1)*xrel**4 + 4*c(2)*xrel**3 + 3*c(3)*xrel**2) / offset
472	   end if

518	subroutine get_damat_0d(mol, nshell, offset, hubbard, gexp, qvec, dadr, dadL, atrace)
519	   !> Molecular structure data
520	   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
521	   !> Number of shells for each atom
522	   integer, intent(in) :: nshell(:)
523	   !> Index offset for each shell
524	   integer, intent(in) :: offset(:)
525	   !> Hubbard parameter for each shell and species
526	   real(wp), intent(in) :: hubbard(:, :, :, :)
527	   !> Exponent of Coulomb kernel
528	   real(wp), intent(in) :: gexp
529	   !> Partial charge vector
530	   real(wp), intent(in) :: qvec(:)
531	   !> Derivative of interactions with respect to cartesian displacements
532	   real(wp), intent(out) :: dadr(:, :, :)
533	   !> Derivative of interactions with respect to strain deformations
534	   real(wp), intent(out) :: dadL(:, :, :)
535	   !> On-site derivatives with respect to cartesian displacements
536	   real(wp), intent(out) :: atrace(:, :)
537	
538	   integer :: iat, jat, izp, jzp, ii, jj, ish, jsh
539	   real(wp) :: vec(3), r1, gam, arg, dtmp, dG(3), dS(3, 3)
540	   real(wp), allocatable :: itrace(:, :), didr(:, :, :), didL(:, :, :)
541	
542	   atrace(:, :) = 0.0_wp
543	   dadr(:, :, :) = 0.0_wp
544	   dadL(:, :, :) = 0.0_wp
545	
546	   !$omp parallel default(none) &
547	   !$omp shared(atrace, dadr, dadL, mol, qvec, hubbard, nshell, offset, gexp) &
548	   !$omp private(iat, izp, ii, ish, jat, jzp, jj, jsh, gam, r1, vec, dG, dS, dtmp, arg) &
549	   !$omp private(itrace, didr, didL)
550	   allocate(itrace, source=atrace)
551	   allocate(didr, source=dadr)
552	   allocate(didL, source=dadL)
553	   !$omp do schedule(runtime)
554	   do iat = 1, mol%nat
555	      izp = mol%id(iat)
556	      ii = offset(iat)
557	      do jat = 1, iat-1
558	         jzp = mol%id(jat)
559	         jj = offset(jat)
560	         vec = mol%xyz(:, iat) - mol%xyz(:, jat)
561	         r1 = norm2(vec)
562	         do ish = 1, nshell(iat)
563	            do jsh = 1, nshell(jat)
564	               gam = hubbard(jsh, ish, jzp, izp)
565	               dtmp = 1.0_wp / (r1**gexp + gam**(-gexp))
566	               dtmp = -r1**(gExp-2.0_wp) * dtmp * dtmp**(1.0_wp/gExp)
567	               dG = dtmp*vec
568	               dS = spread(dG, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3)
569	               itrace(:, ii+ish) = +dG*qvec(jj+jsh) + itrace(:, ii+ish)
570	               itrace(:, jj+jsh) = -dG*qvec(ii+ish) + itrace(:, jj+jsh)
571	               didr(:, iat, jj+jsh) = +dG*qvec(ii+ish) + didr(:, iat, jj+jsh)
572	               didr(:, jat, ii+ish) = -dG*qvec(jj+jsh) + didr(:, jat, ii+ish)
573	               didL(:, :, jj+jsh) = +dS*qvec(ii+ish) + didL(:, :, jj+jsh)
574	               didL(:, :, ii+ish) = +dS*qvec(jj+jsh) + didL(:, :, ii+ish)
575	            end do
576	         end do
577	      end do
578	   end do
579	   !$omp critical (get_damat_0d_)
580	   atrace(:, :) = atrace + itrace
581	   dadr(:, :, :) = dadr + didr
582	   dadL(:, :, :) = dadL + didL
583	   !$omp end critical (get_damat_0d_)
584	   deallocate(didL, didr, itrace)

590	subroutine get_damat_3d(mol, nshell, offset, hubbard, gexp, rcut, wsc, alpha, qvec, &
591	      & dadr, dadL, atrace)
592	   !> Molecular structure data
593	   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
594	   !> Number of shells for each atom
595	   integer, intent(in) :: nshell(:)
596	   !> Index offset for each shell
597	   integer, intent(in) :: offset(:)
598	   !> Hubbard parameter for each shell and species
599	   real(wp), intent(in) :: hubbard(:, :, :, :)
600	   !> Exponent of Coulomb kernel
601	   real(wp), intent(in) :: gexp
602	   !> Long-range cutoff
603	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rcut
604	   !> Wigner-Seitz image information
605	   type(wignerseitz_cell), intent(in) :: wsc
606	   !> Convergence factor for Ewald sum
607	   real(wp), intent(in) :: alpha
608	   !> Partial charge vector
609	   real(wp), intent(in) :: qvec(:)
610	   !> Derivative of interactions with respect to cartesian displacements
611	   real(wp), intent(out) :: dadr(:, :, :)
612	   !> Derivative of interactions with respect to strain deformations
613	   real(wp), intent(out) :: dadL(:, :, :)
614	   !> On-site derivatives with respect to cartesian displacements
615	   real(wp), intent(out) :: atrace(:, :)
616	
617	   integer :: iat, jat, izp, jzp, img, ii, jj, ish, jsh
618	   real(wp) :: vol, gam, wsw, vec(3), dG(3), dS(3, 3)
619	   real(wp) :: dGd(3), dSd(3, 3), dGr(3), dSr(3, 3)
620	   real(wp), allocatable :: itrace(:, :), didr(:, :, :), didL(:, :, :)
621	   real(wp), allocatable :: dtrans(:, :), rtrans(:, :)
622	
623	   atrace(:, :) = 0.0_wp
624	   dadr(:, :, :) = 0.0_wp
625	   dadL(:, :, :) = 0.0_wp
626	
627	   vol = abs(matdet_3x3(mol%lattice))
628	   call get_dir_trans(mol%lattice, alpha, conv, dtrans)
629	   call get_rec_trans(mol%lattice, alpha, vol, conv, rtrans)
630	
631	   !$omp parallel default(none) shared(atrace, dadr, dadL) &
632	   !$omp shared(mol, wsc, alpha, vol, dtrans, rtrans, qvec, hubbard, nshell, offset, gexp, &
633	   !$omp& rcut) private(iat, izp, jat, jzp, img, ii, jj, ish, jsh, gam, wsw, vec, dG, dS, &
634	   !$omp& dGr, dSr, dGd, dSd, itrace, didr, didL)
635	   allocate(itrace, source=atrace)
636	   allocate(didr, source=dadr)
637	   allocate(didL, source=dadL)
638	   !$omp do schedule(runtime)
639	   do iat = 1, mol%nat
640	      izp = mol%id(iat)
641	      ii = offset(iat)
642	      do jat = 1, iat-1
643	         jzp = mol%id(jat)
644	         jj = offset(jat)
645	         do img = 1, wsc%nimg(jat, iat)
646	            vec = mol%xyz(:, iat) - mol%xyz(:, jat) - wsc%trans(:, wsc%tridx(img, jat, iat))
647	            wsw = 1.0_wp / real(wsc%nimg(jat, iat), wp)
648	            call get_damat_rec_3d(vec, vol, alpha, 0.0_wp, rtrans, dGr, dSr)
649	            do ish = 1, nshell(iat)
650	               do jsh = 1, nshell(jat)
651	                  gam = hubbard(jsh, ish, jzp, izp)
652	                  call get_damat_dir_3d(vec, gam, gexp, rcut, alpha, dtrans, dGd, dSd)
653	                  dG = (dGd + dGr) * wsw
654	                  dS = (dSd + dSr) * wsw
655	                  itrace(:, ii+ish) = +dG*qvec(jj+jsh) + itrace(:, ii+ish)
656	                  itrace(:, jj+jsh) = -dG*qvec(ii+ish) + itrace(:, jj+jsh)
657	                  didr(:, iat, jj+jsh) = +dG*qvec(ii+ish) + didr(:, iat, jj+jsh)
658	                  didr(:, jat, ii+ish) = -dG*qvec(jj+jsh) + didr(:, jat, ii+ish)
659	                  didL(:, :, jj+jsh) = +dS*qvec(ii+ish) + didL(:, :, jj+jsh)
660	                  didL(:, :, ii+ish) = +dS*qvec(jj+jsh) + didL(:, :, ii+ish)
661	               end do
662	            end do
663	         end do
664	      end do
665	
666	      wsw = 1.0_wp / real(wsc%nimg(iat, iat), wp)
667	      do img = 1, wsc%nimg(iat, iat)
668	         vec = wsc%trans(:, wsc%tridx(img, iat, iat))
669	         call get_damat_rec_3d(vec, vol, alpha, 0.0_wp, rtrans, dGr, dSr)
670	         do ish = 1, nshell(iat)
671	            do jsh = 1, ish-1
672	               gam = hubbard(jsh, ish, izp, izp)
673	               call get_damat_dir_3d(vec, gam, gexp, rcut, alpha, dtrans, dGd, dSd)
674	               dS = (dSd + dSr) * wsw
675	               didL(:, :, ii+jsh) = +dS*qvec(ii+ish) + didL(:, :, ii+jsh)
676	               didL(:, :, ii+ish) = +dS*qvec(ii+jsh) + didL(:, :, ii+ish)
677	            end do
678	            gam = hubbard(ish, ish, izp, izp)
679	            call get_damat_dir_3d(vec, gam, gexp, rcut, alpha, dtrans, dGd, dSd)
680	            dS = (dSd + dSr) * wsw
681	            didL(:, :, ii+ish) = +dS*qvec(ii+ish) + didL(:, :, ii+ish)
682	         end do
683	      end do
684	   end do
685	   !$omp critical (get_damat_3d_)
686	   atrace(:, :) = atrace + itrace

688	   dadL(:, :, :) = dadL + didL
689	   !$omp end critical (get_damat_3d_)
690	   deallocate(didL, didr, itrace) 
691	   !$omp end parallel

695	!> Calculate real space contributions for a pair under 3D periodic boundary conditions
696	subroutine get_damat_dir_3d(rij, gam, gexp, rcut, alp, trans, dg, ds)
697	   !> Distance between pair
698	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rij(3)
699	   !> Hubbard parameter
700	   real(wp), intent(in) :: gam
701	   !> Exponent for interaction kernel
702	   real(wp), intent(in) :: gexp
703	   !> Long-range cutoff
704	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rcut
705	   !> Convergence factor
706	   real(wp), intent(in) :: alp
707	   !> Translation vectors to consider
708	   real(wp), intent(in) :: trans(:, :)
709	   !> Derivative with respect to cartesian displacements
710	   real(wp), intent(out) :: dg(3)
711	   !> Derivative with respect to strain deformations
712	   real(wp), intent(out) :: ds(3, 3)
713	
714	   integer :: itr
715	   real(wp) :: vec(3), r1, r2, gtmp, atmp, alp2, fcut, dcut
716	
717	   dg(:) = 0.0_wp
718	   ds(:, :) = 0.0_wp
719	
720	   alp2 = alp*alp
721	
722	   do itr = 1, size(trans, 2)
723	      vec(:) = rij + trans(:, itr)
724	      r1 = norm2(vec)
725	      if (r1 < eps) cycle
726	      r2 = r1*r1
727	      fcut = fsmooth(r1, rcut)
728	      dcut = dsmooth(r1, rcut)
729	      gtmp = 1.0_wp / (r1**gexp + gam**(-gexp))
730	      gtmp = -r1**(gexp-2.0_wp) * gtmp * gtmp**(1.0_wp/gexp) * fcut - (1.0_wp-fcut)/(r2*r1) &
731	         & + dcut * (gtmp**(1.0_wp/gexp) * r1 - 1.0_wp) / r2
732	      atmp = -2*alp*exp(-r2*alp2)/(sqrtpi*r2) + erf(r1*alp)/(r2*r1)
733	      dg(:) = dg + (gtmp + atmp) * vec
734	      ds(:, :) = ds + (gtmp + atmp) * spread(vec, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3)
735	   end do
736	
737	end subroutine get_damat_dir_3d

739	!> Calculate reciprocal space contributions for a pair under 3D periodic boundary conditions
740	subroutine get_damat_rec_3d(rij, vol, alp, qpc, trans, dg, ds)
741	   !> Distance between pair
742	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rij(3)
743	   !> Cell volume
744	   real(wp), intent(in) :: vol
745	   !> Convergence factor
746	   real(wp), intent(in) :: alp
747	   !> Pseudo-quadrupole contribution
748	   real(wp), intent(in) :: qpc
749	   !> Translation vectors to consider
750	   real(wp), intent(in) :: trans(:, :)
751	   !> Derivative with respect to cartesian displacements
752	   real(wp), intent(out) :: dg(3)
753	   !> Derivative with respect to strain deformations
754	   real(wp), intent(out) :: ds(3, 3)
755	
756	   integer :: itr
757	   real(wp) :: fac, vec(3), g2, gv, expk, sink, cosk, alp2, fqp
758	   real(wp), parameter :: unity(3, 3) = reshape(&
759	      & [1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1], shape(unity))
760	
761	   dg(:) = 0.0_wp
762	   ds(:, :) = 0.0_wp
763	   fac = 4*pi/vol
764	   alp2 = alp*alp
765	   fqp = 2*qpc*qpc
766	
767	   do itr = 1, size(trans, 2)
768	      vec(:) = trans(:, itr)
769	      g2 = dot_product(vec, vec)
770	      if (g2 < eps) cycle
771	      gv = dot_product(rij, vec)
772	      expk = fac * exp(-0.25_wp*g2/alp2)/g2
773	      cosk = cos(gv) * expk
774	      sink = sin(gv) * expk
775	      dg(:) = dg - sink * vec
776	      ds(:, :) = ds + cosk &
777	         & * ((2.0_wp/g2 + 0.5_wp/alp2 + 0.5_wp*fqp) * spread(vec, 1, 3)*spread(vec, 2, 3) &
778	         &     - unity * (1.0_wp + g2*fqp))
779	   end do
780	
781	end subroutine get_damat_rec_3d

Usage: tblite [run] [options] <input>

Evaluates the tight-binding model on the provided input structure.
Periodic calculations are performed automatically for periodic input formats.
Reads .CHRG and .UHF files if present in the same directory as the input.

Supported geometry input formats are:

- Xmol/xyz files (xyz, log)
- Turbomole's coord, riper's periodic coord (tmol, coord)
- DFTB+ genFormat geometry inputs as cluster, supercell or fractional (gen)
- VASP's POSCAR/CONTCAR input files (vasp, poscar, contcar)
- Protein Database files, only single files (pdb)
- Connection table files, molfile (mol) and structure data format (sdf)
- Gaussian's external program input (ein)

Options

      --spin <int>         Set number of unpaired electrons, overwrites .UHF file

15	!> Coordination number implementation using a double exponential counting function as in GFN2-xTB
16	module mctc_ncoord_dexp

18	   use mctc_io, only : structure_type

29	      !> Covalent radii

41	   real(wp),parameter :: kb = 20.0_wp
42	   !> Offset of the second counting function

51	subroutine new_dexp_ncoord(self, mol, cutoff, rcov, cut)
52	   !> Coordination number container
53	   type(dexp_ncoord_type), intent(out) :: self
54	   !> Molecular structure data
55	   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
56	   !> Real space cutoff
57	   real(wp), intent(in), optional :: cutoff
58	   !> Covalent radii
59	   real(wp), intent(in), optional :: rcov(:)
60	   !> Cutoff for the maximum coordination number
61	   real(wp), intent(in), optional :: cut

63	   if (present(cutoff)) then

65	   else

67	   end if

71	      self%rcov(:) = rcov
72	   else
73	      self%rcov(:) = get_covalent_rad(mol%num)
74	   end if
75	   
76	   self%directed_factor = 1.0_wp
77	
78	   if (present(cut)) then

88	!> Double-exponential counting function for coordination number contributions.
89	elemental function ncoord_count(self, izp, jzp, r) result(count)
90	   !> Coordination number container
91	   class(dexp_ncoord_type), intent(in) :: self
92	   !> Atom i index
93	   integer, intent(in)  :: izp
94	   !> Atom j index
95	   integer, intent(in)  :: jzp
96	   !> Current distance.
97	   real(wp), intent(in) :: r
98	
99	   real(wp) :: rc, count
100	
101	   rc = self%rcov(izp) + self%rcov(jzp)
102	
103	   count = exp_count(ka, r, rc) * exp_count(kb, r, rc + r_shift)
104	
105	end function ncoord_count
106	
107	!> Derivative of the double-exponential counting function w.r.t. the distance.
108	elemental function ncoord_dcount(self, izp, jzp, r) result(count)
109	   !> Coordination number container
110	   class(dexp_ncoord_type), intent(in) :: self
111	   !> Atom i index
112	   integer, intent(in)  :: izp
113	   !> Atom j index
114	   integer, intent(in)  :: jzp
115	   !> Current distance.
116	   real(wp), intent(in) :: r
117	
118	   real(wp) :: rc, count
119	   
120	   rc = self%rcov(izp) + self%rcov(jzp)
121	
122	   count = (exp_dcount(ka, r, rc) * exp_count(kb, r, rc + r_shift) &
123	               & + exp_count(ka, r, rc) * exp_dcount(kb, r, rc + r_shift))
124	
125	end function ncoord_dcount
126	
127	
128	!> Mono-exponential counting function for coordination number contributions.
129	elemental function exp_count(k, r, r0) result(count)
130	   !> Steepness of the counting function.
131	   real(wp), intent(in) :: k
132	   !> Current distance.
133	   real(wp), intent(in) :: r
134	   !> Cutoff radius.
135	   real(wp), intent(in) :: r0
136	
137	   real(wp) :: count
138	
139	   count = 1.0_wp/(1.0_wp+exp(-k*(r0/r-1.0_wp)))
140	
141	end function exp_count
142	
143	!> Derivative of the mono-exponential counting function w.r.t. the distance.
144	elemental function exp_dcount(k, r, r0) result(count)
145	   !> Steepness of the counting function.
146	   real(wp), intent(in) :: k
147	   !> Current distance.
148	   real(wp), intent(in) :: r
149	   !> Cutoff radius.
150	   real(wp), intent(in) :: r0
151	
152	   real(wp) :: count
153	   real(wp) :: expterm
154	
155	   expterm = exp(-k*(r0/r-1.0_wp))
156	   count = (-k*r0*expterm)/(r**2.0_wp*((expterm+1.0_wp)**2.0_wp))
157	
158	end function exp_dcount
159	
160	end module mctc_ncoord_dexp

144	   subroutine ncoord(self, mol, trans, cn)
145	      !> Coordination number container
146	      class(ncoord_type), intent(in) :: self
147	      !> Molecular structure data
148	      type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
149	      !> Lattice points
150	      real(wp), intent(in) :: trans(:, :)
151	      !> Error function coordination number.
152	      real(wp), intent(out) :: cn(:)
153	
154	      integer :: iat, jat, izp, jzp, itr
155	      real(wp) :: r2, r1, rij(3), countf, cutoff2, den
156	
157	      ! Thread-private array for reduction
158	      real(wp), allocatable :: cn_local(:)
159	
160	      cn(:) = 0.0_wp
161	      cutoff2 = self%cutoff**2
162	
163	      !$omp parallel default(none) &
164	      !$omp shared(self, mol, trans, cutoff2, cn) &
165	      !$omp private(jat, itr, izp, jzp, r2, rij, r1, den, countf) &
166	      !$omp private(cn_local)
167	      allocate(cn_local, source=cn)
168	      !$omp do schedule(runtime)
169	      do iat = 1, mol%nat
170	         izp = mol%id(iat)
171	         do jat = 1, iat
172	            jzp = mol%id(jat)
173	            den = self%get_en_factor(izp, jzp)
174	
175	            do itr = 1, size(trans, dim=2)
176	               rij = mol%xyz(:, iat) - (mol%xyz(:, jat) + trans(:, itr))
177	               r2 = sum(rij**2)
178	               if (r2 > cutoff2 .or. r2 < 1.0e-12_wp) cycle
179	               r1 = sqrt(r2)
180	
181	               countf = den * self%ncoord_count(izp, jzp, r1)
182	
183	               cn_local(iat) = cn_local(iat) + countf
184	               if (iat /= jat) then
185	                  cn_local(jat) = cn_local(jat) + countf * self%directed_factor
186	               end if
187	
188	            end do
189	         end do
190	      end do
191	      !$omp end do
192	      !$omp critical (ncoord_)
193	      cn(:) = cn(:) + cn_local(:)
194	      !$omp end critical (ncoord_)
195	      deallocate(cn_local)
196	      !$omp end parallel
197	
198	   end subroutine ncoord

200	   subroutine ncoord_d(self, mol, trans, cn, dcndr, dcndL)
201	      !> Coordination number container
202	      class(ncoord_type), intent(in) :: self
203	      !> Molecular structure data
204	      type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
205	      !> Lattice points
206	      real(wp), intent(in) :: trans(:, :)
207	      !> Error function coordination number.
208	      real(wp), intent(out) :: cn(:)
209	      !> Derivative of the CN with respect to the Cartesian coordinates.
210	      real(wp), intent(out) :: dcndr(:, :, :)
211	      !> Derivative of the CN with respect to strain deformations.
212	      real(wp), intent(out) :: dcndL(:, :, :)
213	
214	      integer :: iat, jat, izp, jzp, itr
215	      real(wp) :: r2, r1, rij(3), countf, countd(3), sigma(3, 3), cutoff2, den
216	
217	      ! Thread-private arrays for reduction
218	      real(wp), allocatable :: cn_local(:)
219	      real(wp), allocatable :: dcndr_local(:, :, :), dcndL_local(:, :, :)
220	
221	      cn(:) = 0.0_wp
222	      dcndr(:, :, :) = 0.0_wp
223	      dcndL(:, :, :) = 0.0_wp
224	      cutoff2 = self%cutoff**2
225	
226	      !$omp parallel default(none) &
227	      !$omp shared(self, mol, trans, cutoff2, cn, dcndr, dcndL) &
228	      !$omp private(jat, itr, izp, jzp, r2, rij, r1, den, countf, countd) &
229	      !$omp private(sigma, cn_local, dcndr_local, dcndL_local)
230	      allocate(cn_local, source=cn)
231	      allocate(dcndr_local, source=dcndr)
232	      allocate(dcndL_local, source=dcndL)
233	      !$omp do schedule(runtime)
234	      do iat = 1, mol%nat
235	         izp = mol%id(iat)
236	         do jat = 1, iat
237	            jzp = mol%id(jat)
238	            den = self%get_en_factor(izp, jzp)
239	
240	            do itr = 1, size(trans, dim=2)
241	               rij = mol%xyz(:, iat) - (mol%xyz(:, jat) + trans(:, itr))
242	               r2 = sum(rij**2)
243	               if (r2 > cutoff2 .or. r2 < 1.0e-12_wp) cycle
244	               r1 = sqrt(r2)
245	
246	               countf = den * self%ncoord_count(izp, jzp, r1)
247	               countd = den * self%ncoord_dcount(izp, jzp, r1) * rij/r1
248	
249	               cn_local(iat) = cn_local(iat) + countf
250	               if (iat /= jat) then
251	                  cn_local(jat) = cn_local(jat) + countf * self%directed_factor
252	               end if
253	
254	               dcndr_local(:, iat, iat) = dcndr_local(:, iat, iat) + countd
255	               dcndr_local(:, jat, jat) = dcndr_local(:, jat, jat) - countd * self%directed_factor
256	               dcndr_local(:, iat, jat) = dcndr_local(:, iat, jat) + countd * self%directed_factor
257	               dcndr_local(:, jat, iat) = dcndr_local(:, jat, iat) - countd
258	
259	               sigma = spread(countd, 1, 3) * spread(rij, 2, 3)
260	
261	               dcndL_local(:, :, iat) = dcndL_local(:, :, iat) + sigma
262	               if (iat /= jat) then
263	                  dcndL_local(:, :, jat) = dcndL_local(:, :, jat) + sigma * self%directed_factor
264	               end if
265	
266	            end do
267	         end do
268	      end do
269	      !$omp end do
270	      !$omp critical (ncoord_d_)
271	      cn(:) = cn(:) + cn_local(:)
272	      dcndr(:, :, :) = dcndr(:, :, :) + dcndr_local(:, :, :)
273	      dcndL(:, :, :) = dcndL(:, :, :) + dcndL_local(:, :, :)
274	      !$omp end critical (ncoord_d_)
275	      deallocate(cn_local, dcndr_local, dcndL_local)
276	      !$omp end parallel
277	
278	   end subroutine ncoord_d

281	   subroutine add_coordination_number_derivs(self, mol, trans, dEdcn, gradient, sigma)
282	
283	      !> Coordination number container
284	      class(ncoord_type), intent(in) :: self
285	
286	      !> Molecular structure data
287	      type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
288	   
289	      !> Lattice points
290	      real(wp), intent(in) :: trans(:, :)
291	   
292	      !> Derivative of expression with respect to the coordination number
293	      real(wp), intent(in) :: dEdcn(:)
294	   
295	      !> Derivative of the CN with respect to the Cartesian coordinates
296	      real(wp), intent(inout) :: gradient(:, :)
297	   
298	      !> Derivative of the CN with respect to strain deformations
299	      real(wp), intent(inout) :: sigma(:, :)
300	   
301	      integer :: iat, jat, izp, jzp, itr
302	      real(wp) :: r2, r1, rij(3), countd(3), ds(3, 3), cutoff2, den
303	
304	      ! Thread-private arrays for reduction
305	      ! Set to zero explicitly as the shared variants are potentially non-zero (inout)
306	      real(wp), allocatable :: gradient_local(:, :), sigma_local(:, :)
307	   
308	      cutoff2 = self%cutoff**2
309	
310	      !$omp parallel default(none) &
311	      !$omp shared(self, mol, trans, cutoff2, dEdcn, gradient, sigma) &
312	      !$omp private(iat, jat, itr, izp, jzp, r2, rij, r1, countd, ds, den) &
313	      !$omp private(gradient_local, sigma_local)
314	      allocate(gradient_local(size(gradient, 1), size(gradient, 2)), source=0.0_wp)
315	      allocate(sigma_local(size(sigma, 1), size(sigma, 2)), source=0.0_wp)
316	      !$omp do schedule(runtime)
317	      do iat = 1, mol%nat
318	         izp = mol%id(iat)
319	         do jat = 1, iat
320	            jzp = mol%id(jat)
321	            den = self%get_en_factor(izp, jzp)
322	
323	            do itr = 1, size(trans, dim=2)
324	               rij = mol%xyz(:, iat) - (mol%xyz(:, jat) + trans(:, itr))
325	               r2 = sum(rij**2)
326	               if (r2 > cutoff2 .or. r2 < 1.0e-12_wp) cycle
327	               r1 = sqrt(r2)
328	
329	               countd = den * self%ncoord_dcount(izp, jzp, r1) * rij/r1
330	
331	               gradient_local(:, iat) = gradient_local(:, iat) + countd &
332	                  & * (dEdcn(iat) + dEdcn(jat) * self%directed_factor)
333	               gradient_local(:, jat) = gradient_local(:, jat) - countd &
334	                  & * (dEdcn(iat) + dEdcn(jat) * self%directed_factor)
335	   
336	               ds = spread(countd, 1, 3) * spread(rij, 2, 3)
337	   
338	               sigma_local(:, :) = sigma_local(:, :) &
339	                  & + ds * (dEdcn(iat) + &
340	                  & merge(dEdcn(jat) * self%directed_factor, 0.0_wp, jat /= iat))
341	            end do
342	         end do
343	      end do
344	      !$omp end do
345	      !$omp critical (add_coordination_number_derivs_)
346	      gradient(:, :) = gradient(:, :) + gradient_local(:, :)
347	      sigma(:, :) = sigma(:, :) + sigma_local(:, :)

   private

   public :: get_mulliken_shell_charges, get_mulliken_atomic_multipoles

subroutine get_mulliken_shell_charges(bas, smat, pmat, n0sh, qsh)
   type(basis_type), intent(in) :: bas
   real(wp), intent(in) :: smat(:, :)
   real(wp), intent(in) :: pmat(:, :, :)
   real(wp), intent(in) :: n0sh(:)
   real(wp), intent(out) :: qsh(:, :)

   integer :: ish, ii, iao, jao, spin
   real(wp) :: psh

   qsh(:, :) = 0.0_wp
   !$omp parallel do default(none) collapse(2) schedule(runtime) &
   !$omp shared(qsh, bas, pmat, smat) private(spin, ish, ii, iao, jao, psh)
   do spin = 1, size(pmat, 3)
      do ish = 1, bas%nsh
         psh = 0.0_wp
         ii = bas%iao_sh(ish)
         do iao = 1, bas%nao_sh(ish)
            do jao = 1, bas%nao
               psh = psh + pmat(jao, ii+iao, spin) * smat(jao, ii+iao)
            end do
         end do
         qsh(ish, spin) = -psh
      end do
   end do

   call updown_to_magnet(qsh)
   qsh(:, 1) = qsh(:, 1) + n0sh

end subroutine get_mulliken_shell_charges


subroutine get_mulliken_atomic_multipoles(bas, mpmat, pmat, mpat)
   type(basis_type), intent(in) :: bas
   real(wp), intent(in) :: mpmat(:, :, :)
   real(wp), intent(in) :: pmat(:, :, :)
   real(wp), intent(out) :: mpat(:, :, :)

   integer ::  iat, ish, is, ii, iao, jao, spin
   real(wp) :: pat(size(mpmat, 1))

   mpat(:, :, :) = 0.0_wp
   !$omp parallel do default(none) collapse(2) schedule(runtime) &
   !$omp shared(bas, pmat, mpmat, mpat) &
   !$omp private(spin, iat, ish, is, ii, iao, jao, pat)
   do spin = 1, size(pmat, 3)
      do iat = 1, size(mpat, 2)
         pat(:) = 0.0_wp
         is = bas%ish_at(iat)
         do ish = 1, bas%nsh_at(iat)
            ii = bas%iao_sh(is + ish)
            do iao = 1, bas%nao_sh(is + ish)
               do jao = 1, bas%nao
                  pat(:) = pat(:) + pmat(jao, ii+iao, spin) * mpmat(:, jao, ii+iao)
               end do
            end do
         end do
         mpat(:, iat, spin) = -pat(:)
      end do
   end do

   call updown_to_magnet(mpat)

end subroutine get_mulliken_atomic_multipoles

subroutine get_mulliken_shell_multipoles(bas, mpmat, pmat, mpsh)

   real(wp), intent(out) :: mpsh(:, :, :)

   integer :: iao, jao, spin, ish, ii
   real(wp) :: psh(size(mpmat, 1))

   mpsh(:, :, :) = 0.0_wp
   !$omp parallel do default(none) collapse(2) schedule(runtime) &
   !$omp shared(bas, pmat, mpmat, mpsh) &
   !$omp private(spin, ish, iao, jao, ii, psh)
   do spin = 1, size(pmat, 3)

         ii = bas%iao_sh(ish)
         do iao = 1, bas%nao_sh(ish)

subroutine get_molecular_dipole_moment(mol, qat, dpat, dpmom)
   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
   real(wp), intent(in) :: qat(:)
   real(wp), intent(in) :: dpat(:, :)
   real(wp), intent(out) :: dpmom(:)

   integer :: iat

   dpmom(:) = 0.0_wp
   do iat = 1, mol%nat
      dpmom(:) = dpmom + mol%xyz(:, iat) * qat(iat) + dpat(:, iat)
   end do
end subroutine get_molecular_dipole_moment

subroutine get_molecular_quadrupole_moment(mol, qat, dpat, qpat, qpmom)
   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
   real(wp), intent(in) :: qat(:)
   real(wp), intent(in) :: dpat(:, :)
   real(wp), intent(in) :: qpat(:, :)
   real(wp), intent(out) :: qpmom(:)

   integer :: iat
   real(wp) :: vec(3), cart(6), tr

   qpmom(:) = 0.0_wp
   do iat = 1, mol%nat
      vec(:) = mol%xyz(:, iat)*qat(iat)
      cart([1, 3, 6]) = mol%xyz(:, iat) * (vec + 2*dpat(:, iat))
      cart(2) = mol%xyz(1, iat) * (vec(2) + dpat(2, iat)) + dpat(1, iat)*mol%xyz(2, iat)
      cart(4) = mol%xyz(1, iat) * (vec(3) + dpat(3, iat)) + dpat(1, iat)*mol%xyz(3, iat)
      cart(5) = mol%xyz(2, iat) * (vec(3) + dpat(3, iat)) + dpat(2, iat)*mol%xyz(3, iat)
      tr = 0.5_wp * (cart(1) + cart(3) + cart(6))
      cart(1) = 1.5_wp * cart(1) - tr
      cart(2) = 3.0_wp * cart(2)
      cart(3) = 1.5_wp * cart(3) - tr
      cart(4) = 3.0_wp * cart(4)
      cart(5) = 3.0_wp * cart(5)
      cart(6) = 1.5_wp * cart(6) - tr
      qpmom(:) = qpmom(:) + qpat(:, iat) + cart
   end do
end subroutine get_molecular_quadrupole_moment

import numpy as np
from math import erf, erfc, exp, sin, cos, sqrt, pi

def compute(lat, r, alpha, nT=4, nG=20, sd=True, dd=False, sq=False):
    # lattice columns, cubic assumed
    a=np.diag(lat).copy(); assert np.allclose(lat,np.diag(np.diag(lat)))
    vol=abs(np.linalg.det(lat))
    # translations: all integer combos [-nT,nT]^3
    Ts=[]
    for i in range(-nT,nT+1):
        for j in range(-nT,nT+1):
            for k in range(-nT,nT+1):
                Ts.append(lat@np.array([i,j,k]))
    # direct code correction with f=1
    dir_sd=np.zeros(3); dir_dd=np.zeros((3,3)); dir_sq=np.zeros(6)
    for T in Ts:
        vec=r+T
        rr=np.linalg.norm(vec)
        if rr<1e-12: continue
        g1=1.0/rr; g3=g1**3; g5=g3*g1*g1
        arg=rr*alpha; arg2=arg*arg
        expt=exp(-arg2)/sqrt(pi)
        erft=-erf(arg)*g1
        e1=g1*g1*(erft+2*expt*alpha)
        e2=g1*g1*(e1+4*expt*alpha**3/3)
        # f=1 full direct = code + damped (f=1)
        dir_sd += vec*(g3+e1)
        dir_dd += np.eye(3)*(g3+e1) - 3*np.outer(vec,vec)*(g5+e2)
        # sq correction? use same e2/e1 traceless: C_sq for code f=1 = vec_i vec_j (g5+e2) - delta/3*(g3+e1)
        C=np.outer(vec,vec)*(g5+e2) - np.eye(3)*(g3+e1)/3.0
        dir_sq += pack(C)
    # reciprocal code
    rec_sd=np.zeros(3); rec_dd=np.zeros((3,3)); rec_sq=np.zeros(6)
    fac=4*pi/vol
    # G = 2pi n_i / a_i
    for i in range(-nG,nG+1):
        for j in range(-nG,nG+1):
            for k in range(-nG,nG+1):
                if i==0 and j==0 and k==0: continue
                G=2*pi*np.array([i,j,k])/np.diag(lat)
                g2=G@G; gv=G@r
                expk=fac*exp(-0.25*g2/(alpha*alpha))/g2
                sink=sin(gv)*expk; cosk=cos(gv)*expk
                rec_sd += 2*G*sink
                rec_dd += np.outer(G,G)*cosk
                C=np.outer(G,G)*cosk
                # code sq: diagonal + offdiag (no trace removal in loop)
                rec_sq += pack(C)
    return dir_sd+rec_sd, dir_dd+rec_dd, dir_sq+rec_sq

def pack(C):
    return np.array([C[0,0],2*C[0,1],C[1,1],2*C[0,2],2*C[1,2],C[2,2]])

lat=np.eye(3)*10.0

    sd,dd,sq=compute(lat,r,alpha,nT=5,nG=30)
    print('alpha',alpha,'sd',sd,'dd',dd,'sq',sq)

import numpy as np
from math import erf, exp, cos, sin, sqrt, pi

def dir_dd(r, alpha):
    # code direct correction + damped f=1 for dipole-dipole tensor
    rr=np.linalg.norm(r)
    if rr<1e-12: return np.zeros((3,3))
    g1=1/rr; g3=g1**3; g5=g3*g1*g1
    arg=rr*alpha; arg2=arg*arg
    expt=exp(-arg2)/sqrt(pi)
    erft=-erf(arg)*g1
    e1=g1*g1*(erft+2*expt*alpha)
    e2=g1*g1*(e1+4*expt*alpha**3/3)
    return np.eye(3)*(g3+e1)-3*np.outer(r,r)*(g5+e2)

def rec_dd(r, alpha, lat, nG=20):
    a=np.diag(lat); vol=np.linalg.det(lat); fac=4*pi/vol
    A=np.zeros((3,3))
    for i in range(-nG,nG+1):

subroutine new_basis(self, mol, nshell, cgto, acc)
   !> Instance of the basis set data
   type(basis_type), intent(out) :: self
   !> Molecular structure data
   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
   !> Number of shells per species
   integer, intent(in) :: nshell(:)
   !> Contracted Gaussian basis functions for each shell and species
   type(cgto_type), intent(in) :: cgto(:, :)
   !> Calculation accuracy

   real(wp) :: min_alpha

   self%nsh_id = nshell
   self%cgto = cgto
   self%intcut = integral_cutoff(acc)

   ! Make count of shells for each atom

   ! Create mapping between atoms and shells
   self%nsh = sum(self%nsh_at)
   allocate(self%ish_at(mol%nat), self%sh2at(self%nsh))
   ii = 0

      do ish = 1, self%nsh_at(iat)

      end do

!> Determine required real space cutoff for the basis set
pure function get_cutoff(self, acc) result(cutoff)
   !> Instance of the basis set data
   type(basis_type), intent(in) :: self
   !> Accuracy for the integral cutoff
   real(wp), intent(in), optional :: acc
   !> Required realspace cutoff
   real(wp) :: cutoff

   real(wp) :: intcut
   real(wp), parameter :: max_cutoff = 40.0_wp

   if (present(acc)) then
      intcut = integral_cutoff(acc)
   else
      intcut = self%intcut
   end if
   ! ai * aj * cutoff2 / (ai + aj) == intcut
   cutoff = min(sqrt(2.0_wp*intcut/self%min_alpha), max_cutoff)

end function get_cutoff


!> Create integral cutoff from accuracy value
pure function integral_cutoff(acc) result(intcut)
   !> Accuracy for the integral cutoff
   real(wp), intent(in) :: acc
   !> Integral cutoff
   real(wp) :: intcut

   real(wp), parameter :: min_intcut = 5.0_wp, max_intcut = 25.0_wp, &
      & max_acc = 1.0e-4_wp, min_acc = 1.0e+3_wp

   intcut = clip(max_intcut - 10*log10(clip(acc, min_acc, max_acc)), min_intcut, max_intcut)
end function integral_cutoff

      !> Damping exponent for quadratic terms

      procedure, private :: load_from_array
      !> Write parametrization data to parameter array

!> Read parametrization data from TOML data structure
subroutine load_from_toml(self, table, error)
   !> Instance of the parametrization data
   class(multipole_record), intent(inout) :: self
   !> Data structure
   type(toml_table), intent(inout) :: table
   !> Error handling
   type(error_type), allocatable, intent(out) :: error

   type(toml_table), pointer :: child
   integer :: stat

   call get_value(table, k_damped, child, requested=.false.)
   if (.not.associated(child)) then
      call fatal_error(error, "No entry for damped multipole electrostatic found")
      return
   end if

   call get_value(child, k_dmp3, self%dmp3, stat=stat)
   if (stat /= 0) then
      call fatal_error(error, "Invalid entry for multipole range separation parameter")
      return
   end if
   call get_value(child, k_dmp5, self%dmp5, stat=stat)
   if (stat /= 0) then
      call fatal_error(error, "Invalid entry for multipole range separation parameter")
      return
   end if
   call get_value(child, k_kexp, self%kexp, stat=stat)
   if (stat /= 0) then
      call fatal_error(error, "Invalid entry for multipole damping function exponent")
      return
   end if
   call get_value(child, k_shift, self%shift, stat=stat)
   if (stat /= 0) then
      call fatal_error(error, "Invalid entry for CN multipole shift")
      return
   end if
   call get_value(child, k_rmax, self%rmax, stat=stat)
   if (stat /= 0) then
      call fatal_error(error, "Invalid entry for maximum multipole radius")
      return
   end if

!> Calculate the multipole interaction matrix for finite systems
subroutine get_multipole_matrix_0d(mol, rad, kdmp3, kdmp5, amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq)
   !> Molecular structure data
   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
   !> Multipole damping radii for all atoms
   real(wp), intent(in) :: rad(:)
   !> Damping function for inverse quadratic contributions
   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp3
   !> Damping function for inverse cubic contributions
   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp5
   !> Interaction matrix for charges and dipoles
   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_sd(:, :, :)
   !> Interaction matrix for dipoles and dipoles
   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_dd(:, :, :, :)
   !> Interaction matrix for charges and quadrupoles
   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_sq(:, :, :)

   integer :: iat, jat
   real(wp) :: r1, vec(3), g1, g3, g5, fdmp3, fdmp5, tc(6), rr

   !$omp parallel do default(none) schedule(runtime) collapse(2) &
   !$omp shared(amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq, mol, rad, kdmp3, kdmp5) &
   !$omp private(r1, vec, g1, g3, g5, fdmp3, fdmp5, tc, rr)
   do iat = 1, mol%nat
      do jat = 1, mol%nat
         if (iat == jat) cycle
         vec(:) = mol%xyz(:, iat) - mol%xyz(:, jat)
         r1 = norm2(vec)
         g1 = 1.0_wp / r1
         g3 = g1 * g1 * g1
         g5 = g3 * g1 * g1

         rr = 0.5_wp * (rad(jat) + rad(iat)) * g1
         fdmp3 = 1.0_wp / (1.0_wp + 6.0_wp * rr**kdmp3)
         fdmp5 = 1.0_wp / (1.0_wp + 6.0_wp * rr**kdmp5)

         amat_sd(:, jat, iat) = amat_sd(:, jat, iat) + vec * g3 * fdmp3
         amat_dd(:, jat, :, iat) = amat_dd(:, jat, :, iat) &
            & + unity * g3*fdmp5 - spread(vec, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3) * 3*g5*fdmp5
         tc(2) = 2*vec(1)*vec(2)*g5*fdmp5
         tc(4) = 2*vec(1)*vec(3)*g5*fdmp5
         tc(5) = 2*vec(2)*vec(3)*g5*fdmp5
         tc(1) = vec(1)*vec(1)*g5*fdmp5
         tc(3) = vec(2)*vec(2)*g5*fdmp5
         tc(6) = vec(3)*vec(3)*g5*fdmp5
         amat_sq(:, jat, iat) = amat_sq(:, jat, iat) + tc
      end do
   end do
end subroutine get_multipole_matrix_0d

subroutine get_dir_trans(lattice, alpha, rmax, kdmp3, kdmp5, conv, trans)
   !> Lattice parameters
   real(wp), intent(in) :: lattice(:, :)
   !> Parameter for Ewald summation
   real(wp), intent(in) :: alpha
   !> Maximum damping radius for the multipole interactions
   real(wp), intent(in) :: rmax
   !> Damping exponent for inverse quadratic contributions
   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp3
   !> Damping exponent for inverse cubic contributions
   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp5
   !> Tolerance for Ewald summation
   real(wp), intent(in) :: conv
   !> Translation vectors
   real(wp), allocatable, intent(out) :: trans(:, :)

   real(wp) :: rcut

   ! The real-space cutoff has to resolve two different decays.  The first one
   ! is the Ewald-screened Coulomb tail, which is determined by the screening
   ! parameter.  The second one is the residual of the damped multipole kernel
   ! approaching its long-range limit, which decays as a power law and is
   ! controlled by the damping radius and exponent.  Use the larger of the two
   ! cutoffs so that both representations of a periodic cell contain the same
   ! physical lattice images.
   rcut = get_dir_cutoff(alpha, conv)
   rcut = max(rcut, get_damp_cutoff(rmax, kdmp3, 2.0_wp, conv))
   rcut = max(rcut, get_damp_cutoff(rmax, kdmp5, 3.0_wp, conv))

   call get_lattice_points([.true.], lattice, rcut, trans)

end subroutine get_dir_trans


!> Real-space cutoff required to converge the power-law tail of the damped
!> multipole interaction kernel below the requested tolerance.
pure function get_damp_cutoff(rr, kexp, order, conv) result(rcut)
   !> Maximum damping radius
   real(wp), intent(in) :: rr
   !> Damping exponent
   real(wp), intent(in) :: kexp
   !> Inverse distance order of the undamped kernel (2 for 1/R^2, 3 for 1/R^3)
   real(wp), intent(in) :: order
   !> Tolerance for the damped tail
   real(wp), intent(in) :: conv
   !> Required real-space cutoff
   real(wp) :: rcut

   ! For r >> rr the damped kernel differs from its long-range limit by
   !   1 - 1/(1 + 6*(rr/r)**kexp) <= 6*(rr/r)**kexp,
   ! hence the residual is bounded by 6*rr**kexp/r**(kexp+order).
   rcut = (6.0_wp * rr**kexp / conv)**(1.0_wp / (kexp + order))

end function get_damp_cutoff

I repaired the periodic multipole electrostatics implementation in `source/src/tblite/coulomb/multipole.f90`.

## Root cause

The GFN2-xTB anisotropic electrostatics had incorrect reciprocal-space Ewald coefficients:

- The charge–dipole reciprocal kernel was doubled (`2*G*sin(...)` instead of `G*sin(...)`).
- The charge–quadrupole reciprocal kernel had the wrong sign and magnitude (`+G_a G_b` instead of `-(1/3) G_a G_b` for the traceless quadrupole representation).

These errors made the anisotropic multipole energy depend on the Ewald splitting parameter, and therefore on the periodic-cell representation. The corresponding reciprocal gradient routines were updated consistently.

I also made the multipole real-space image generation use a representation-independent physical cutoff. The damped multipole kernel approaches its long-range limit as a power law, so the original charge-only Ewald cutoff left different physical image sets in a unit cell versus its supercell. The new cutoff adds the damping-radius/exponent-dependent tail convergence on top of the Ewald cutoff.

- Analytical forces were checked against numerical energy derivatives (max deviation ~`2e-4 eV/Å` at forces of ~`19 eV/Å`).
- A clean `rm -rf .build && python reproduce.py` build succeeds from the modified source, and `ninja -C .build` builds all default targets.

Only `source/src/tblite/coulomb/multipole.f90` was modified; `reproduce.py` and public interfaces/units are unchanged.
